name: AN/TPQ-50 LSTAR air-surveillance radar (SRC)
description: L-band 360 deg air-surveillance radar (AN/TPQ-50), the search sensor in the LIDS family. SRC publishes >35 km instrumented in air-surveillance mode and >15 km in counterfire mode, neither conditioned on a UAS class; the 10 km ring is a small-UAS planning figure.

rangeAccuracyM.note: Planning factor: 30 m for a pulse-compressed medium-range surveillance waveform; no early-warning radar in the library publishes a figure and the nearest sourced value is the RPS-42 brochure 50 m.

azimuthAccuracyDeg.note: Planning factor: about a tenth of a 2 to 3° S- or L-band beam (beam splitting or monopulse at 10 dB SNR, Skolnik), so 0.3°; no early-warning radar in the library publishes a figure.

elevationAccuracyDeg.note: Planning factor: 0.5° for a stacked-beam or e-scan elevation estimate on a 2 to 3° beam; no early-warning radar in the library publishes a figure.

falseAlarmRatePerScan.note: Planning factor: PLACARD_PFA 1e-6 (src/model/types.ts) times about 1e6 range-azimuth-Doppler cells per scan of a 360° surveillance volume gives about one false alarm per scan over the whole coverage; this 360° radar is recorded at 1. No vendor publishes a false-alarm rate.

dwellTimeS.note: Planning factor: SRC publishes no dwell for the non-rotating electronically steered AN/TPQ-50. The literature CPI of 20 ms for drone-detection e-scan radars is used. Open literature on X/Ku-band drone-detection AESAs gives a CPI of about 20 ms at 5 kHz PRF (about 100 pulses; arXiv 2307.10326) and about 30 ms at 6 kHz (about 180 pulses; MDPI Drones 7(5):316), and notes that a 2.7 ms dwell barely resolves micro-Doppler.

pulsesPerDwell.note: Planning factor: 20 ms dwell at a 2.5 kHz PRF (60 km unambiguous range, above the >35 km instrumented air-surveillance range on the SRC sheet) gives 50 pulses. SRC publishes no PRF or pulse count.
